title: Secure External Early-User Ingress

chosen_ingress.reason: No BIDFinder reverse proxy or public 80/443 listener exists; a named tunnel provides managed HTTPS without router port forwarding and adds one direct hop to loopback FastAPI.
chosen_ingress.public_hostname_configuration: External BIDFINDER_PUBLIC_URL plus external ~/.config/bidfinder/cloudflared.yml; no hostname is hard-coded in application logic.

public_surface.frontend_serving: FastAPI serves existing apps/web same-origin when repository is present; dynamic /config.js sets browser API base to window.location.origin. file:// behavior remains unchanged.

auth_cors_session.authentication: Existing auth policy preserved; Phase 4D proved unauthenticated full query returns HTTP 401.
auth_cors_session.cors: Explicit allowlist retained; no wildcard; configured public origin is added from BIDFINDER_PUBLIC_URL.
auth_cors_session.proxy_headers: Trusted only when the direct peer is configured loopback 127.0.0.1 or ::1; arbitrary public X-Forwarded-* headers are ignored.
auth_cors_session.cookies: Public mode defaults to Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax when BIDFINDER_PUBLIC_URL is configured; local mode remains practical.
auth_cors_session.csrf: SameSite=Lax plus same-origin public web/API blocks cross-site cookie POSTs; no new state-changing GET route added.
auth_cors_session.external_validation: BLOCKED: no configured public hostname or tunnel credential.

abuse_and_limits.rate_limit_model: Existing in-process per-client-IP and user-agent buckets
abuse_and_limits.note: Process-local MVP guard; not a distributed rate-limiting service.

headers_and_errors.frontend_csp: Existing compatible CSP meta retained; connect-src self supports same-origin API.
headers_and_errors.public_errors: Unhandled exceptions return generic sanitized text; server logs retain only path and exception type/context.
headers_and_errors.access_logging: FastAPI access logging remains disabled; tunnel wrapper does not enable request-body logging.

lifecycle.dependency_order: Typesense -> FastAPI -> ingress via systemd ordering
lifecycle.independent_stop: public-stop stops only ingress; FastAPI and Typesense remain local.
lifecycle.persistence: systemd user service; public-enable enables startup after WSL user-service recovery.
lifecycle.restart_loop_behavior: Ingress uses Wants/After, Restart=on-failure, 10s backoff; backend unavailability does not require an ingress restart loop.
lifecycle.credential_rotation: Replace external Cloudflare credentials-file, restart, then revoke old tunnel credential in Cloudflare.

validation.local_typesense_health_during_audit: PARTIAL: service active but still loading after normal restart; health returned 503 during sampled window
validation.public_https: BLOCKED: cloudflared absent and no named tunnel/hostname configuration
validation.typesense_external_exposure: NOT_RUN externally; no public ingress was activated. Local binding proof PASS.
validation.full_unittest_discovery: PARTIAL: repository discovery has unrelated MSC package/import and long-running safety tests; focused changed-area suites pass.

current_startup_sample.typesense_service: active, normal generation load in progress

resources.interpretation: Startup sample is not a steady-state benchmark; inherited Phase 4D steady-state RSS was approximately 7.5 GB with no sustained saturation or swap-growth signal.

rollback: bash infra/runtime/bidfinder-install.sh public-stop; use public-disable to remove automatic ingress startup. Local FastAPI/Typesense remain available.
limitations: Real external validation requires the operator's Cloudflare account, named tunnel, DNS hostname, cloudflared binary, and external network.
Windows must run, WSL must be active, the machine must stay awake, and Internet connectivity must remain available.
Windows reboot/update or WSL shutdown causes an outage; enable public mode or run public-start after recovery.
Single-machine hosting; no HA and no distributed abuse guard.
